def run(k):
    g=G[k+' input']; O=G[k+' output']
    bg=comps_any(g)[0]
    Ci=comps_of(g,bg)
    rem=[cell for cl in Ci if len(cl)==1 for cell in cl]
    kept=[cl for cl in Ci if len(cl)>1]
    rebuilt=[[bg]*len(g[0]) for _ in range(len(g))]
    for c0,cl in kept:
        for a,b in cl: rebuilt[a][b]=c0
    for (r,c) in sorted(rem):
        best=min(kept,key=lambda cl:min(max(abs(r-a),abs(c-b)) for a,b in cl))
        rebuilt[r][c]=best[0] if False else [cb for cb,_ in kept if _ is best][0]
    return rebuilt==O
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:

def norm(cl):

    return frozenset((a-min(rs),b-min(cs)) for a,b in cl)

    Oi=objs(gi,bi)
    # majority color = color whose total cells > others? use counts per color
    cnt=Counter(c for c,_ in Oi)
    maj=max(cnt,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    sizes={c:[len(cl) for cl in v] for c,v in itertools.groupby(sorted(Oi),key=lambda t:t[0])} if False else None

    # assign each stray to nearest multicolor obj, recolor, place at original position; compare
    rebuilt=[[bi]*len(gi[0]) for _ in gi]
    kept=[(c0,cl) for c0,cl in Oi if len(cl)>1]
    absorbed=[]
    for c0,cl in Oi:
        if len(cl)==1: absorbed.append((c0,cl[0]))

            for a,b in cl: rebuilt[a][b]=c0
    for c0,(r,c) in absorbed:
        best=min(kept,key=lambda o:min(max(abs(r-a),abs(c-b)) for a,b in o[1]))

def absorbed_config(gi):
    bg=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    O=comps(gi,bg)
    # candidate noise colors: colors with no 4-adjacent same-color cell
    def has4nbr(cl):
        s=set(cl); return any((r-1,c) in s or (r+1,c) in s or (r,c-1) in s or (r,c+1) in s for r,c in cl)
    noise=[c for c,cl in O if len(cl)>1 and not has4nbr(cl) or len(cl)==1 and not True] 
    # simpler: noise = colors whose every comp lacks a 4-neighbor same color
    noise_c={}
    for c,cl in O:
        s=set(cl)
        adj=any((r-1,c_) in s or (r+1,c_) in s or (r,c_-1) in s or (r,c_+1) in s for r,c_ in cl)
        if not adj: noise_c.setdefault(c,set()).add((r,c_))
    return bg,O,noise_c
# check per demo which colors qualify as noise and whether recolored-on-nearest-keptobj explains growth

    pred=[[bg]*len(gi[0]) for _ in gi]
    for c,cl in O:

        for r,cc in cl: pred[r][cc]=c
    for c,(sr,sc) in nc.items():
        best=min([(min(max(abs(sr-a),abs(sc-b)) for a,b in o[1])) for o in O if o[0]!=c],key=lambda t:t)[0]
        pass
    # instead: assign each noise cell to nearest kept-multi-object by Chebyshev
    kept=[o for o in O if o[0] not in nc]
    for c,cells in nc.items():
        for sr,sc in cells:
            best=min(kept,key=lambda o:min(max(abs(sr-a),abs(sc-b)) for a,b in o[1]))
            pred[sr][sc]=best[0]
    exp=[sum(r.count(cc) for r in go) for cc in sorted({x for r in go for x in r if cc!=bg})]
    print(' pred counts match output?', {c:sum(r.count(c) for r in pred) for c in set(nc)|{}} )

def f(k,verbose=False):
    gi=G['Demo pair %d input'%k]; go=G['Demo pair %d output'%k]
    bg=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    O=comps(gi,bg)
    objs=[(c,set(cl)) for c,cl in O if len(cl)>1]
    singles=[(c,r,cc) for c,cl in O if len(cl)==1 for r,cc in cl]
    H=len(gi); W=len(gi[0])
    occs=[set(cs) for _,cs in objs]
    colors=[o[0] for o in objs]
    for c,sr,sc in singles:
        best=min(objs,key=lambda o:min(max(abs(sr-a),abs(sc-b)) for a,b in o[1]))
        i=objs.index(best); occs[i].add((sr,sc))
    others=None
    changed=True
    while changed:
        changed=False
        # simultaneous moves: compute target for each object (max down/left until blocked)
        newpos={}
        blocked=set()
        for i,(col,cells) in enumerate(zip(colors,occs)):
            # greedy: try down until blocked, then left
            cs=list(cells)
            cur=set(cs)
            d=1
            while True:
                tgt={(r+d,c) for r,c in cur}
                if all(0<=r<H for r,_ in tgt) and all(c>=0 for _,c in tgt) and not (tgt & {(r,c) for j in range(len(occs)) if j!=i for r,c in occs[j]}):
                    cur=tgt; d+=1
                else: break
            cur2=set()
            cc_=-1
            while True:
                tgt={(r,c-1) for r,c in cur}
                if all(r>=0 for r,_ in tgt) and all(c-1>=0 for _,c in tgt) and not (tgt & {(r,c) for j in range(len(occs)) if j!=i for r,c in occs[j]}):
                    cur=tgt; cc_-=1
                else: break
            newpos[i]=cur
            if cur!=cells: changed=True
        occs=list(newpos.values())
    out=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    occupied=set()
    for i,(col,_) in enumerate(zip(colors,occs)):
        for r,c in occs[i]: out[r][c]=col; occupied.add((r,c))
    rs=[r for r,_ in occupied]; cc_=[c for _,c in occupied]
    return [[out[r][c] for c in range(min(cc_),max(cc_)+1)] for r in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1)]

def slide(gi, go=None):
    bg=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    H=len(gi); W=len(gi[0])
    O=comps(gi,bg)
    objs=[(c,set(cl)) for c,cl in O if len(cl)>1]
    singles=[(c,r,cc) for c,cl in O if len(cl)==1 for r,cc in cl]
    cnt={}
    for c,cl in O: cnt.setdefault(c,[]).append(cl)
    erase=max(cnt,key=lambda c:len(cnt[c]))
    occs=[]; colors=[]
    for c,cls in cnt.items():
        if c!=erase: occs.extend([set(cl) for cl in cls]); colors.append(c)
    for cell in cnt[erase]:
        for r0,c0 in cell:
            best=min(range(len(occs)),key=lambda j:min(max(abs(r0-a),abs(c0-b)) for a,b in occs[j]))
            occs[best].add((r0,c0))
    def blocked(i,cand):
        return any(not(0<=r<H and 0<=c<W) for r,c in cand) or (cand & {p for j in range(len(occs)) if j!=i for p in occs[j]})
    # greedy: repeatedly take the object that can still move furthest down-left? try orders
    results=[]
    for orderf in ['top','left','size','any']:
        occs2=list(occs); colors2=colors[:]
        order=sorted(range(len(occs2)), key=lambda j:(min(r for r,_ in occs2[j]), min(c for _,c in occs2[j]))) if orderf=='top' else \
               sorted(range(len(occs2)), key=lambda j:min(c for _,c in occs2[j])) if orderf=='left' else \
               sorted(range(len(occs2)), key=lambda j:-len(occs2[j])) if orderf=='size' else range(len(occs2))
        respos=[]
        remaining=set(order)
        cur=occs2[:]
        others=None
        while remaining:
            i=remaining.pop()
            cs=cur[i]; occupied={p for j in range(len(cur)) if j!=i for p in cur[j]}
            cand=None
            d=(H+1,W+1)
            while True:
                nd=dr,dc=-1 if cand is None else dr,dc
                break
            # slide down-left together
            r=next(min(r for r,_ in cs)); c=next(min(c for _,c in cs))
            best_move=None
            dr=1; dc=1
            step=0
            pos=cs
            while True:
                np={(r+dr, c+dc) for r,c in pos}
                if not all(0<=a<H and 0<=b<W for a,b in np) or np & occupied: break
                pos=np; dr+=1; dc-=1; step+=1
            best_move=step; respos.append(best_move)
            cur[i]=pos; remaining.discard(i)
        print(orderf,[ (j,sorted(respos[j],reverse=True)[:2]) for j in range(len(occs2))])
    return oc

def solve(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps(g,bg)
    objs=[]; noises=[]
    for c,cl in cs:
        if len(cl)>1: objs.append([c,set(cl)])
        else: noises.append((c,list(cl)[0]))
    assert noises
    # absorb strays into nearest multi obj (Chebyshev), at original offset, recolored to that obj's color
    for nc,pos in noises:
        best=min(range(len(objs)),key=lambda j:min(max(abs(pos[0]-a),abs(pos[1]-b)) for a,b in objs[j][1]))
        objs[best][1].add(pos)
    objs.sort(key=lambda o:(min(r for r,_ in o[1]), min(c for _,c in o[1])))  # order by top-left
    occ=set()
    placed=[set(o[1]) for o in objs]
    for i,o in enumerate(objs):
        s=set(o[1]); c=o[0]
        # slide down until blocked by already-placed objects or bottom (relative: until next step overlaps occ or out of range)
        while True:
            cand={(r+1,x) for r,x in s}
            if not all(r<H for r,x in cand) or any(pos in occ for pos in cand): break
            s=cand
        # slide left similarly
        while True:
            cand={(r,c-1) for r,c in s}
            if not all(c>=0 for r,c in cand) or any(pos in occ for pos in cand): break
            s=cand
        placed[i]=s; occ|=s
    res=[[objs[i][0] if pos in placed[i] else bg for i,pos in enumerate([(i,p) for i,p in [(j,q) for j in range(len(objs)) for q in placed[j]]])] for _ in [0]]
    return None

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    objs=comps_of(g,bg)
    multi=[(col,set(c)) for col,c in objs if len(c)>=2]
    cur=[list(s) for _,s in multi]
    singles=[(col,[c]) for col,c in objs if len(c)==1]
    for col,cells in singles:
        r,c=next(iter(cells))
        i=min(range(len(cur)),key=lambda j:min(abs(r-a)+abs(c-b) for a,b in cur[j]))
        cur[i].append((r,c))
    # sort objects by... they slide diagonally; simulate simultaneous diagonal steps
    changed=True
    while changed:
        changed=False
        ncur=[set(x) for x in cur]
        for i in range(len(ncur)):
            oth=set().union(*[ncur[j] for j in range(len(ncur)) if j!=i],[])
            nc={(a-1,b-1) for a,b in ncur[i]}
            if min(a for a,_ in nc)<0 or min(b for _,b in nc)<0 or nc & oth: continue
            if any(abs(a-x)<=1 and abs(b-y)<=1 for a,b in nc for x,y in oth): continue
            ncur[i]=nc; changed=True
        cur=[list(s) for s in ncur]
    r0=min(a for cs in cur for a,b in cs); c0=min(b for cs in cur for a,b in cs)
    h=max(a for cs in cur for a,b in cs)-r0+1
    w=max(b for cs in cur for a,b in cs)-c0+1
    res=[[3]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i,cs in enumerate(cur):
        col=multi[i][0]
        for a,b in cs: res[a-r0][b-c0]=col
    return [row[:] for row in res]

        i=min(range(len(cur)),key=lambda j:min(abs(r-a)+abs(c-b) for a,b in cur[j]))

    def adj(cs,others): return any(abs(a-x)<=1 and abs(b-y)<=1 for a,b in cs for x,y in others)
    while True:
        moved=False

            oth=set().union(*[cur[j] for j in range(len(cur)) if j!=i],[])
            nc={(a-1,b-1) for a,b in cur[i]}

    h=max(a for cs in cur for a,b in cs)-r0+1
    w=max(b for cs in cur for a,b in cs)-c0+1
    res=[[3]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i,cs in enumerate(cur):
        col=multi[i][0]
        for a,b in cs: res[a-r0][b-c0]=col
    return [row[:] for row in res]

def crop(g,bg):
    ps=[(i,j) for i in range(len(g)) for j in range(len(g[0])) if g[i][j]!=bg]

    return [row[c0:c0+w] for row in g[r0:r0+h]]
